How It's Made

The Handmade Process

From herb to bar, every batch passes through the same four unhurried stages.

01

Source

Herbs and botanicals are sourced fresh, batch by batch.

02

Cold-Press

Ingredients are cold-pressed into a coconut-oil base to protect potency.

03

Cure

Bars are left to cure slowly, developing a firmer, longer-lasting texture.

04

Hand-Finish

Each bar is trimmed, stamped, and checked by hand before packing.

About Us

Made Slowly, On Purpose

Arogya Naturals began as a small kitchen experiment — a search for soap that used real herbs at real concentrations, instead of a fragrance built to imitate them.

Every bar we sell is still poured, cured, and trimmed by hand in small batches. We keep formulas short on purpose: one hero botanical, a coconut-oil base, and vitamin E — nothing added just to fill a label.

— The Arogya Naturals Studio

Questions

Frequently Asked

How do I place an order?

Choose a soap, tap "View Details," then "Order Now." Fill in your delivery details and confirm — your order is sent straight to us on WhatsApp for confirmation.

Are these soaps suitable for daily use?

Yes. All four formulas use a gentle coconut-oil base and are safe for everyday cleansing, including sensitive skin.

What does "Pack of 2" include?

Every listing ships two full-size bars of the same soap. You can order multiple packs of the same or different soaps.

How long does delivery take?

Most orders are dispatched within 24–48 hours and delivered within 3–6 business days depending on your location.

Do you ship across India?

Yes, we currently deliver pan-India. Share your pincode while ordering and we'll confirm serviceability on WhatsApp.

Stay in the Loop

New herb drops, care tips, and small-batch restock alerts — no spam, ever.
